title: Logic Police
description: Finds what's WRONG with an idea, offer, pitch, plan, or strategy before a customer, investor, regulator, or the market finds it. Uses rotating adversarial personas — skeptical CFO, angry customer, burned-out journalist — and tags every hole by severity.
